text.title: 屏风后的声音
text.situation:
屏风后，另一位讲解员邀请访客听一段短录音，描述自己注意到什么。这张桌属于心理学小组。展览讨论知觉：人们如何通过感官注意并解读信息。声音按钮旁的卡片把记忆与理解称为认知过程。这里没有评分，访客比较自己的描述。

访客：我觉得两个人在争吵。
讲解员：另一位访客听到的是普通提问。看不到说话者时，我们可能以不同方式理解这个情境。
访客：那张图展示脑里所有东西吗？
讲解员：不是。它简化展示研究者研究的一些脑回路，并非完整地图。

这个听觉活动使用声音。
先比较各自听到了什么，再读书面描述。

paragraphs.en: Behind a screen, another guide invited visitors to listen to a short recording and describe what they noticed. The table belonged to a psychology group. Its display concerned perception: how people notice and interpret information through their senses. Beside the sound buttons, a card described remembering and understanding as cognitive processes. No one was being given a score; visitors compared their own descriptions.

paragraphs.en:
Visitor: I thought the two voices were arguing.
Guide: Another visitor heard an ordinary question. We may perceive the situation differently without seeing the speakers.
Visitor: Is that picture a map of everything in the brain?
Guide: No. It is a simplified drawing of some brain circuits researchers study. It is not a complete map.

The aural activity uses sound.
Compare what you heard before reading the written description.

acceptableAnswers: 心理学小组设置了有关知觉的活动。

S10.E03.P02.cue: 描述心理过程及不同理解。
acceptableAnswers: 记忆是认知过程。访客对交谈的理解不同。
